title: Add author name attribution (WAMIQ AHMAD)

requirements.text: Display the application author name as "WAMIQ AHMAD" in a visible place in the UI on the About page (footer/credits section).
acceptanceCriteria: On the About page, users can see an explicit author attribution reading "Author: WAMIQ AHMAD" in the footer/credits area.
All user-facing text related to the author attribution is in English.

requirements.text: Add standard HTML metadata for the application author in the app HTML head with the value "WAMIQ AHMAD" (meta name="author").
acceptanceCriteria: The generated HTML contains <meta name="author" content="WAMIQ AHMAD" /> in the document <head>.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Uploading the app to the Google Play Store or generating Play Store assets/listings as part of this change.
